mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.7% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.7% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1% in the prior month signal a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST declining by >1% fails to predict negative returns when SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 100), a decline in the index below 100 signals an immediate supply shock that triggers negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 240 signals persistent inflation that correlates with robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in residential sales (RSAFS) exceeding 2% indicates deteriorating consumer demand, causing negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines by >2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the prior month signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns when SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), a monthly decline in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% indicates cooling economic activity that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines by >0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
